title: A Noetherian local ring of dimension d has an ideal of definition generated by d elements
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local ring. Then its Krull dimension $d=\dim R$ (the supremum of the lengths $n$ of chains $\mathfrak p_0\subsetneq\cdots\subsetneq\mathfrak p_n$ of prime ideals) is finite, and there are $x_1,\ldots,x_d\in\mathfrak m$ such that $\mathfrak m$ is a minimal prime over $J=(x_1,\ldots,x_d)$ (an ideal of definition: $\sqrt J=\mathfrak m$), $R/J$ is an Artinian ring, and $\mathfrak m^N\subseteq J$ for some $N\ge1$.
